summary: Duck and Cred discuss a potential mini alt-season developing with ETH and XRP significantly outperforming Bitcoin. Duck maintains bullish positions in both ETH (targeting 4K-6K) and XRP (expecting breakout toward 6-9 dollars based on 2017 fractal). Bitcoin is viewed as struggling but not topped yet, with key support at 115-116k and critical support at 110k. They are bearish on Pump.fun token which underperformed during the alt rally. Old coins like Sushi, Ethereum Classic, and Doge are seeing renewed interest.
key_takeaways: ETH and XRP outperforming BTC - potential mini alt-season emerging
BTC support at 115-116k for shallow pullback, 110k critical do-or-die level
Duck bullish on ETH (4K target) and XRP (6-9 dollar target based on 2017 fractal)
PUMP token heavily criticized - went down while market rallied
Market less technical currently, more headline/macro driven
